headline: Elon Musk said at an X event in Texas that AI music videos should be called "awesome-core" rather than "slop-core", and social media users mocked him.
score_reason: Pool score kept: light satire and reaction, with no new facts beyond the remark.
importance_line: What changed: nothing beyond a spoken remark and the online jeering; it shows how divided opinion on AI-made music is, and it rests on one short clip and a humour site's choice of replies.
summary: The Poke, a UK humour site, reports that Elon Musk said at an X Takeover event in Texas that calling AI music videos "slop-core" is "a misnomer" and that they are "awesome-core", quoting a clip posted by an X account. The rest of the piece is a roundup of mocking replies, so it is reaction and satire rather than news analysis.
notes: Event date not given by The Poke; the clip was not seen.
